summary: Pose-conditioned generation on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across Kling 2-6 Motion Control Pro / Standard (transfer the motion / blocking of a reference video onto a target character), community Wan 2-2 Animate (audio-driven character animation with pose conditioning), and Z-Image…
whenToUse: Use when generating an image or video that must follow a reference pose, skeleton or motion, such as transferring a dance onto a new character.
